changelog: Initial release of Flight Delay Compensation
summary: Check if a delayed, cancelled, or overbooked flight qualifies for cash compensation under EU261, UK261, US DOT, Canada APPR, Brazil ANAC, Turkey SHY, or India DGCA rules. Calculates exact amounts by distance tier, evaluates airline extraordinary-circumstances defenses, tracks claim deadlines, and generates ready-to-send claim letters. Use when a flight disruption occurred and the user wants to know their rights or file a claim.
